claims.claim: Cognitive Orchestration/Nexus formalizes agentic behavior as a recursive, tuple-based memory update and retrieval process.
claims.note: This is the proposed framework's core mechanism.

claims.claim: The Transformer architecture achieves state-of-the-art translation quality with BLEU scores of 28.4 on WMT 2014 English-to-German and 41.8 on WMT 2014 English-to-French.
CoT prompting improves performance on complex tasks like arithmetic and multi-hop inference.
Toolformer allows models to learn to use tools in a self-supervised manner but is limited by an inability to chain tool outputs.
Generative agents use memory and reflection to maintain social dynamics, but retrieval is decoupled from tool-based problem solving.
The proposed retrieval score balances semantic relevance with temporal recency to improve grounded task performance.
